test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I:** All mobiles are electronics.

**Statement II:** All laptops are electronics.

**Conclusion I: **Some mobiles are laptops.

**Conclusion II: **All mobiles are laptops.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Statement:

I. All mobiles are electronics.

II. All laptops are electronics.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05dc46d58d3ad60b6f2645bd92ca66d1fe6673a28ee00a97720deaa1a4cc61c2.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some mobiles are laptops. - False (Because No definite relation given between mobiles and laptop, so it can be possible only).

(ii) All mobiles are laptops - False (Because No definite relation given between mobiles and laptop, so it can be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion I or II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
